items.claim: At MT 40:1 the clause put forward as the dateline is the subordinate fourteenth-year reckoning after the city was struck; the verse's dateline proper stands at its head - בְּעֶשְׂרִ֣ים וְחָמֵ֣שׁ שָׁנָ֣ה לְ֠גָלוּתֵנוּ בְּרֹ֨אשׁ הַשָּׁנָ֜ה בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹ֗דֶשׁ - and it is the head clause, not the quoted one, that carries the month and day terms the dateline class requires. The quoted clause holds a year word alone, and the verse does not begin with it (Ezek.40.1).
items.both_sides: Onset side: every other onset fact here is true on the bytes - the year-bearing dateline at MT 40:1 is the fourteenth and last of the fourteen such verses, the hand-of-YHWH construct stands in its seven-verse class, the transport verb closes the verse, and the vision-of-God frame at MT 40:2 stands in its three-verse class on the construct pair (MT 1:1, 8:3, 40:2). Close side: MT 40:4 carries the address to the prophet and the charge to declare, with no close formula, and MT 40:5 begins the measuring verb run that holds for eighteen verses to MT 41:5; nothing on either side moves the seam, so only the dateline quotation needs correcting.

suggested_fix.fact: the dateline at this verse is the twenty-fifth-year-of-our-exile formula with its new-year and tenth-of-the-month terms, standing at the verse head; the fourteenth-year clause after the city was struck is a subordinate reckoning inside the same verse and carries no month or day term
